title: GitHub backend: repositories, members, invites, archive/unarchive, project files and the local project folder
story: Underneath Grillo, the GitHub store can now create a private project repository or connect an existing one, including an empty one, keep members and invitations, save sources, sessions, PRD structure, versions and scores in .grillo/ through a local clone, and archive or reopen a project. Before this, every repository store call answered "not implemented yet". There is no screen yet.
no_qa_reason: Store methods only; no screen or command a person can drive until the project screens land.
